challenges.name: repository-cache-policies
challenges.title: Give the repository its cache policies
challenges.description: The courier app fetched every screen from the network on every open (slow on 3G, useless offline), except restaurant menus, which a teammate cached forever, so couriers quoted week-old prices. The repository now serves three policies: `CACHE_FIRST` for menus (fresh cache, else the network), `STALE_WHILE_REVALIDATE` for the order list (show the cache at once, refresh it in the background when it is older than `TTL`), and `NETWORK_FIRST` for payout amounts (the network, else a cache entry at most `MAX_STALE` minutes old). The editor holds the repository with these blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that each policy emits the right values in order (`cache:<v>`, `cache:<v> (stale)`, `network:<v>`, `error:offline`), only a successful fetch updates the cache and its time, and an entry is fresh only while it is younger than `TTL`. Run plays a timeline of network changes and reads, and prints what each read returned and what the cache holds.
hints: For each policy, write down the order of three questions: is there a cache entry, is it fresh, does the network answer? The answers decide which values are emitted and in which order.
Look at what `fetchAndStore` writes when `fetch` returns null, and at what `isFresh` compares: an entry's age is `now - fetchedAt`, compared with `TTL`.

A weather repository: `if (cached != null && now - cached.at < TTL) return listOf(cached.temp)`; `val fresh = api(city) ?: return listOfNotNull(cached?.temp, "offline")`; `store[city] = Entry(fresh, now)`; and for stale-while-revalidate, emit the cached value first and then the fetched one.

tests.name: CACHE_FIRST: a fresh menu skips the network, a stale one is refetched
tests.input:
seed menu v1 0
net up v2
at 5
get menu cache_first
at 15
get menu cache_first
at 20
get menu cache_first

tests.name: Offline: stale data with an error, or just the error when nothing is cached
tests.input:
seed menu v1 0
net down
at 30
get menu cache_first
get menu swr
get orders cache_first
get orders swr

tests.name: STALE_WHILE_REVALIDATE: the cache at once, the network only when it is old
tests.input:
seed orders o1 0
net up o2
at 5
get orders swr
at 12
get orders swr
at 13
get orders swr

tests.name: NETWORK_FIRST: a recent payout from cache when offline, never a very old one
tests.input:
seed payout 120k 0
net down
at 30
get payout network_first
at 90
get payout network_first
net up 135k
get payout network_first

tests.name: A failed refresh does not make old data look fresh
tests.input:
seed menu v1 0
net down
at 15
get menu cache_first
net up v3
at 16
get menu cache_first
tests.expected:
@15 get menu cache_first -> [cache:v1 (stale), error:offline] cache=v1@0
@16 get menu cache_first -> [network:v3] cache=v3@16
